elements.texte:
[cheerful] Imagine you get the name wrong.

You want to drop the table enrollments underscore excel, but you type customers instead.

The deletion is refused.

Your turn!

The orders, loyalty, enrollments and cards tables refer to the customers table.

As long as a foreign key refers to it, a table can’t be dropped.

elements.texte:
[cheerful] And what if you forget the end of the name?

You want to drop the table enrollments underscore excel, but you type enrollments.

No table refers to the enrollments table.

Your turn!

It would be dropped, with its seven enrollments, without a single error.

A dropped table can’t be recovered: always read the name over before running.

[cheerful] Karim adds the query to his go-live script.

On the NutriBoost database, the copy is dropped.

The script also runs on the test server, where the copy doesn’t exist.

The query fails, and the go-live stops.

Your turn!

IF EXISTS goes between TABLE and the table name.

If the table doesn’t exist, nothing is dropped and no error appears.
